reviewer_separation: The reviewer must be separately scoped from the producer report and must not rely on the report as the source of any retained byte root or semantic conclusion.
procedure: Recompute every retained source, manuscript, Comparator, Lean, Mathlib, and reproduction-evidence byte root from its exact locator and revision.
Read the source statement, manuscript theorem and limit equation, Lean definitions, Lean declaration, and imported definitions from their exact pinned bytes.
Evaluate definition mapping, quantifiers, hypotheses, conclusion, source timing and disagreement, and unresolved questions independently.
Compare the independent matrix with the producer report and enumerate every disagreement.
Report pass only when the producer conclusion follows from the exact retained inputs and all required nonclaims remain explicit.
mechanical_checks: Every root uses the sha256:<64 lowercase hex> form.
The report names exactly the six required review dimensions.
The report conclusion is faithful, not_faithful, or indeterminate.
The report retains discrepancies and nonclaims as arrays rather than omitting them.
semantic_checks: The complete graph, total edge-colouring, monochromatic triangle, least-order, asymptotic variable, and positive-infinity limit meanings are preserved.
Any stronger hypothesis, weaker conclusion, hidden abstraction, source-status conflict, or unresolved interpretation is surfaced.
nonclaims: A mechanically well-formed report is a verified statement-fidelity conclusion.
Lean, Nanoda, or Comparator passage establishes novelty, source fidelity, community acceptance, or Vela Standing.
A passing Verification Record changes accepted scientific state.
